title: Factors Impacting Developer Efficiency: Results from an Adaptive Longitudinal Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.16596v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: Developer efficiency is driven by technical, organizational, and personal factors, yet few longitudinal studies explore how these factors evolve over time. Objective: This study investigates the primary factors hindering the perceived efficiency of developers in a consulting and professional development context, analyzing how these factors vary across recurring data collection cycles and how they are described qualitatively. Method: We conducted a mixed-methods longitudinal case study applying the Adaptive Developer Efficiency Monitoring Method (ADEMM) to 27 external software developers, combining twelve waves of periodic surveys with eighteen semi-structured interviews, analyzed through statistical and thematic analysis. translated_title: 影响开发者效率的因素：一项适应性纵向研究的结果
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16596v1 公告类型：新 摘要：背景：开发者效率受技术、组织和个人因素驱动，但很少有纵向研究探讨这些因素如何随时间演变。目标：本研究调查了在咨询和专业发展背景下，阻碍开发者感知效率的主要因素，分析了这些因素在不同数据收集周期中的变化及其定性描述方式。方法：我们进行了一项混合方法的纵向案例研究，将适应性开发者效率监测方法（ADEMM）应用于27名外部软件开发者，结合了十二轮定期调查和十八次半结构化访谈，并通过统计和主题分析进行处理。结果：最常见的瓶颈是组织依赖和等待外部验证，这些在结构上保持稳定，其次是技术知识差距，随着开发者经验的积累而减少。
tldr: 本研究通过纵向混合方法发现，组织依赖和等待外部验证是开发者效率的主要稳定瓶颈，而技术知识差距随时间推移而减少。
en_tdlr: This study, using a longitudinal mixed-methods approach, found that organizational dependencies and waiting for external validation are the primary stable bottlenecks to developer efficiency, while technical knowledge gaps decrease over time.
